verses.text: One man dey from Ramathaim Zophim, for di hill country of Ephraim, and im name na Elkanah, di pikin of Jeroham, di pikin of Elihu, di pikin of Tohu, di pikin of Zuph, one Ephraimite;
and e get two wives. Di name of one na Hannah, and di name of di other na Peninnah. Peninnah get pikin dem, but Hannah no get pikin.
Dis man dey go up from im city every year to worship and to sacrifice to di Lord of Armies for Shiloh. Di two pikin man dem of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, priests of di Lord, dey dere.
When di day come wey Elkanah sacrifice, e give portions to Peninnah im wife, and to all im pikin man dem and im pikin woman dem;
but to Hannah e give double portion, because e love Hannah, but di Lord don shut im womb.
Im rival provoke am seriously, to make am fret, because di Lord don shut im womb.
As Elkanah dey do so year by year, when Hannah go up to di Lord house, so Peninnah dey provoke am; so Hannah dey weep, and no dey eat.
Elkanah, im husband, talk to am say, “Hannah, why you dey weep? Why you no dey eat? Why your heart dey grieve? I no better to you pass ten pikin man dem?”
So Hannah rise up after dem don eat for Shiloh, and after dem don drink. Now Eli di priest dey sit on im seat by di doorpost of di Lord temple.
Hannah dey bitter for soul, and e pray to di Lord, and weep bitterly.

E make vow, talk say, “Di Lord of Armies, if you go truly look di affliction of your servant, and remember me, and no forget your servant, but give your servant one boy, den I go give am to di Lord all di days of im life, and no razor go come on im head.”
As e dey continue to pray before di Lord, Eli watch im mouth.
Now Hannah dey speak for im heart. Only im lips dey move, but dem no hear im voice. So Eli think say e drunk.
Eli talk to am say, “How long you go dey drunk? Put away your wine!”
Hannah answer, “No, my oga, I na woman wey get sorrowful spirit. I no drink wine or strong drink, but I pour out my soul before di Lord.
No think say your servant na wicked woman; because na from di abundance of my complaint and my provocation I dey speak till now.”
Den Eli answer, “Go in peace; and make di God of Israel grant your petition wey you ask from am.”
E talk say, “Make your servant find favour for your eyes.” So di woman go im way and eat; and im face no sad again.
Dem rise early for morning, worship before di Lord, and return, come to dem house for Ramah. Elkanah sleep with Hannah im wife; and di Lord remember am.
When di time reach, Hannah conceive, born one pikin man; and e name am Samuel, talk say, “Because I ask am from di Lord.”
Di man Elkanah, and all im house, go up to offer di yearly sacrifice and im vow to di Lord.
But Hannah no go up; because e talk to im husband say, “I no go go up until I don wean di pikin; den I go bring am, so that e go appear before di Lord, and stay dere forever.”
Elkanah im husband talk to am say, “Do wetin good for your eyes. Wait until you don wean am. Only make di Lord establish im word.” So di woman wait and breastfeed im pikin man until e wean am.
When e don wean am, e carry am go up with am, with three bulls, one ephah of flour, and one container of wine, and bring am to di Lord house for Shiloh; and di pikin dey young.
Dem kill di bull, and bring di pikin to Eli.
E talk say, “Oh, my oga, as your soul dey live, my oga, I na di woman wey stand by you here, dey pray to di Lord.
I pray for dis pikin; and di Lord don give me my petition wey I ask from am.
So I don give am to di Lord too. As long as e dey live, e don dey given to di Lord.” E worship di Lord dere.
Hannah pray, talk say, “My heart dey rejoice for di Lord! My horn don lift up for di Lord. My mouth don open wide over my enemies, because I dey rejoice for your salvation.
Nobody holy like di Lord, because nobody dey except you, and no rock dey like our God.
No talk so proudly again. Make arrogance no come out of your mouth; because di Lord na God of knowledge, and na by am dem dey weigh actions.
Di bows of di mighty men don break. Di ones wey stumble, strength don gird dem.
Di ones wey full don hire demself out for bread. Di ones wey hungry don stop to hungry. Yes, di barren woman don born seven, and di woman wey get plenty pikin dey waste away.
Di Lord dey kill, and e dey make alive. E dey bring down to Sheol, and e dey bring up.
Di Lord dey make poor, and e dey make rich. E dey bring low, e dey lift up too.

E dey raise di poor from di dust. E dey lift di needy from di dunghill, to make dem sit with princes, and inherit di throne of glory. Because di pillars of di earth na di Lord own. E don set di world on dem.
E go keep di feet of im holy ones, but di wicked go dey silent for darkness; because by strength no man go win.
Di ones wey dey fight di Lord go break to pieces. E go thunder against dem for di sky. Di Lord go judge di ends of di earth. E go give strength to im king, and lift up di horn of im anointed.”
Elkanah go Ramah to im house. Di pikin serve di Lord before Eli di priest.
Now Eli pikin man dem na wicked men. Dem no know di Lord.
Di custom of di priests with di people na say when any man offer sacrifice, di priest servant go come while di meat dey boil, with fork wey get three teeth for im hand;
and e go strike am inside di pan, or kettle, or cauldron, or pot. All wey di fork bring up, di priest go take for imself. Na so dem dey do for Shiloh to all di pikin dem of Israel wey come dere.
Yes, before dem burn di fat, di priest servant go come, talk to di man wey dey sacrifice say, “Give meat make dem roast am for di priest; because e no go accept boiled meat from you, but raw.”
If di man talk to am say, “Dem go surely burn di fat first, and den take as plenty as your soul want;” den e go talk say, “No, but you must give am to me now; and if no, I go take am by force.”
Di sin of di young men very big before di Lord; because di men despise di offering of di Lord.
But Samuel dey serve before di Lord, as pikin, dress with linen ephod.
Moreover im mama dey make am small robe, and dey bring am from year to year, when e come up with im husband to offer di yearly sacrifice.
Eli bless Elkanah and im wife, and talk say, “Make di Lord give you offspring from dis woman for di petition wey dem ask from di Lord.” Den dem go dem own home.
Di Lord visit Hannah, and e conceive, and born three pikin man dem and two pikin woman dem. Di pikin Samuel grow before di Lord.
Now Eli very old, and e hear all wetin im pikin man dem dey do to all Israel, and how dem dey sleep with di women wey dey serve for di door of di Tent of Meeting.
E talk to dem say, “Why una dey do dis kind things? Because I dey hear about una evil dealings from all dis people.
No, my pikin man dem; because e no be good report wey I dey hear. Una dey make di Lord people disobey.
If one man sin against another, God go judge am; but if man sin against di Lord, who go intercede for am?” Even so, dem no listen to di voice of dem papa, because di Lord don decide to kill dem.
Di pikin Samuel dey grow, and e dey increase for favour with di Lord, and with men too.
One man of God come to Eli, talk to am say, “Dis na wetin di Lord talk, ‘I reveal myself to your papa house, when dem dey for Egypt for Pharaoh house?

I choose am from all di tribes of Israel to be my priest, to go up to my altar, to burn incense, to wear ephod before me? I give your papa house all di offerings of di pikin dem of Israel wey dem make by fire?
Why you dey kick my sacrifice and my offering, wey I command for my dwelling, and honour your pikin man dem pass me, to make una fat with di best of all di offerings of Israel my people?’

Dis na why di Lord, God of Israel, dey talk, ‘I really talk say your house, and di house of your papa, go waka before me forever;’ but now di Lord talk, ‘E no go be so; because di ones wey honour me, I go honour dem, and di ones wey despise me go dey cursed.
Look, di days dey come wey I go cut off your arm, and di arm of your papa house, so that no old man go dey for your house.
You go see di affliction of my dwelling, for all di wealth wey God go give Israel; and no old man go dey for your house forever.
Di man of yours wey I no go cut off from my altar, go make your eyes waste away, and grieve your heart. All di increase of your house go die for di flower of dem age.
Dis na di sign to you wey go come on your two pikin man dem, on Hophni and Phinehas: for one day di two of dem go die.
I go raise one faithful priest for myself, wey go do according to wetin dey for my heart and my soul. I go build am sure house; and e go waka before my anointed forever.

E go happen say, everybody wey remain for your house go come bow down to am for one piece of silver and one loaf of bread, and go talk, “Please put me for one of di priest work, so that I go eat piece of bread.”’”
Di pikin Samuel dey serve di Lord before Eli. Di word of di Lord no dey plenty for dem days. Vision no dey come plenty.
For dat time, Eli don lie down for im place, and im eyes don begin dim, so tay e no fit see,
and God lamp never go out, and Samuel don lie down to sleep for di Lord temple, wia God ark dey,
di Lord call Samuel; and e talk say, “Here I dey.”
E run go Eli, talk say, “Here I dey; because you call me.” E talk say, “I no call. Go lie down again.” E go lie down.
Di Lord call again, “Samuel!” Samuel rise go Eli, talk say, “Here I dey; because you call me.” E answer, “I no call, my pikin man. Go lie down again.”
Now Samuel never know di Lord, and di word of di Lord never reveal to am.
Di Lord call Samuel again di third time. E rise go Eli, talk say, “Here I dey; because you call me.” Eli perceive say di Lord don call di pikin.
So Eli talk to Samuel say, “Go, lie down. If e call you, you go talk say, ‘Speak, di Lord; because your servant dey hear.’” So Samuel go lie down for im place.
Di Lord come, stand, and call like di other times, “Samuel! Samuel!” Den Samuel talk say, “Speak; because your servant dey hear.”
Di Lord talk to Samuel say, “Look, I go do one thing for Israel wey go make di two ears of everybody wey hear am tingle.
For dat day I go perform against Eli all wey I don speak about im house, from di beginning reach di end.
Because I don tell am say I go judge im house forever, because of di iniquity wey e know, because im pikin man dem bring curse on demself, and e no restrain dem.
So I don swear to Eli house say di iniquity of Eli house no go remove by sacrifice or offering forever.”
Samuel lie down until morning, and open di doors of di Lord house. Samuel dey fear to tell Eli di vision.
Den Eli call Samuel, talk say, “Samuel, my pikin man!” E talk say, “Here I dey.”
E talk say, “Wetin be di thing wey di Lord speak to you? Please no hide am from me. Make God do so to you, and more also, if you hide anything from me of all di things wey e speak to you.”
Samuel tell am everything, and hide nothing from am. E talk say, “Na di Lord. Make e do wetin good for im eyes.”
Samuel grow, and di Lord dey with am, and no let any of im words fall to di ground.
All Israel from Dan reach Beersheba know say dem establish Samuel to be prophet of di Lord.
Di Lord appear again for Shiloh; because di Lord reveal imself to Samuel for Shiloh by di word of di Lord.
Di word of Samuel come to all Israel. Now Israel go out against di Philistines to battle, and camp beside Ebenezer; and di Philistines camp for Aphek.
Di Philistines arrange demself against Israel. When dem join battle, Israel lose before di Philistines, wey kill about 4,000 men of di army for di field.

When di people don come into di camp, di elders of Israel talk say, “Why di Lord strike us today before di Philistines? Make we carry di ark of di covenant of di Lord from Shiloh come to us, so that e go come among us and save us from di hand of our enemies.”

So di people send go Shiloh; and dem bring from dere di ark of di covenant of di Lord of Armies, wey dey sit above di cherubim. Di two pikin man dem of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, dey dere with di ark of di covenant of God.
When di ark of di covenant of di Lord enter di camp, all Israel shout with big shout, so tay di earth ring again.
When di Philistines hear di noise of di shout, dem talk say, “Wetin di noise of dis big shout for di camp of di Hebrews mean?” Dem understand say di ark of di Lord don enter di camp.
Di Philistines fear, because dem talk say, “God don enter di camp.” Dem talk say, “Woe to us! Because dem never get dis kind thing before.
Woe to us! Who go deliver us from di hand of dis mighty gods? Na dem be di gods wey strike di Egyptians with all kinds of plagues for di wilderness.
Be strong, and behave like men, una Philistines, so that una no go be servants to di Hebrews, as dem don be to una. Show say una be men, and fight!”
Di Philistines fight, and Israel lose, and dem run every man go im tent: and big slaughter happen; because 30,000 foot soldiers of Israel fall.
Dem take di ark of God; and Hophni and Phinehas, di two pikin man dem of Eli, dem kill.
One man of Benjamin run from di army, and come to Shiloh di same day with im clothes tear, and dirt on im head.
When e come, look, Eli dey sit on im seat by di road dey watch; because im heart dey tremble for di ark of God. When di man enter di city, and tell am, all di city cry out.
When Eli hear di noise of di cry, e talk say, “Wetin di noise of dis confusion mean?” Di man hurry, come tell Eli.
Now Eli na 98 years old; and im eyes don fix, so tay e no fit see.
Di man talk to Eli say, “Na me come from di army, and I run today from di army.” E talk say, “How di matter go, my pikin man?”

Di one wey bring di news answer, “Israel don run before di Philistines, and big slaughter don happen among di people too, and your two pikin man dem too, Hophni and Phinehas, don die, and dem don take di ark of God.”
When e mention di ark of God, Eli fall backward from im seat by di side of di gate; and im neck break, and e die; because e na old man, and heavy. E don judge Israel 40 years.

Im pikin wife, Phinehas wife, dey pregnant, near to born: and when e hear di news say dem don take di ark of God, and say im papa-in-law and im husband don die, e bow down and born; because im pains come.
About di time wey e dey die, di women wey dey stand by am talk to am say, “No fear; because you don born pikin man.” But e no answer, and e no pay attention.
E name di pikin Ichabod, talk say, “Di glory don leave Israel;” because dem don take di ark of God, and because of im papa-in-law and im husband.
E talk say, “Di glory don leave Israel, because dem don take di ark of God.”
Now di Philistines don take di ark of God, and dem bring am from Ebenezer go Ashdod.
Di Philistines take di ark of God, bring am enter di house of Dagon, and put am beside Dagon.
When di people of Ashdod rise early for morning, look, Dagon don fall on im face to di ground before di ark of di Lord. Dem take Dagon, and put am for im place again.

When dem rise early di next morning, look, Dagon don fall on im face to di ground before di ark of di Lord; and Dagon head and di two palms of im hands don cut off for di threshold. Only di body of Dagon remain for am.
So di priests of Dagon, and anybody wey enter Dagon house, no dey step on di threshold of Dagon for Ashdod, till today.
But di hand of di Lord heavy on di people of Ashdod, and e destroy dem, and strike dem with tumours, Ashdod and im borders.
When di men of Ashdod see say na so e be, dem talk say, “Di ark of di God of Israel no go stay with us; because im hand hard on us, and on Dagon our god.”

So dem send and gather all di ogas of di Philistines to dem, talk say, “Wetin we go do with di ark of di God of Israel?” Dem answer, “Make dem carry di ark of di God of Israel go Gath.” Dem carry di ark of di God of Israel go dere.
E happen say after dem don carry am go dere, di hand of di Lord dey against di city with very big confusion: and e strike di men of di city, both small and big; and tumours break out on dem.
So dem send di ark of God go Ekron. As di ark of God reach Ekron, di people of Ekron cry out, talk say, “Dem don bring di ark of di God of Israel to us, to kill us and our people!”

So dem send and gather all di ogas of di Philistines together, and dem talk say, “Send di ark of di God of Israel go, make e go back to im own place, so that e no go kill us and our people.” Because deadly panic dey all over di city. Di hand of God very heavy dere.
Di men wey no die, dem strike dem with di tumours; and di cry of di city go up to heaven.
